description: This PHP source file defines the DocumentSoap class, which provides functionality for saving files associated with documents in the SuiteCRM application. It handles decoding base64 encoded files, creating document revisions, and associating these revisions with existing documents.

classes.name: DocumentSoap
classes.description: A class that manages the process of saving files and associating them with document records, primarily for SOAP API interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new UploadFile instance for handling the uploaded file.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Accepts document data, decodes the file if present, creates a new document revision, and associates it with an existing document record.
